words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 与某人有关系或有影响力，能通过这层关系获得便利或机会
words.ex: He has an in with the manager.
words.ex_cn: 他和经理有关系。
words.en: To have influential connections or special access to someone.

words.tr: n. 天堂；天国；
words.ex: He believes he will go to heaven after death.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己死后会去天堂。
words.en: In some religions, heaven is the place where God or the gods live and where good people go after they die.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有退路；有借口可以脱身；有机会退出（承诺、责任等）
words.ex: He has an out if the plan fails.
words.ex_cn: 如果计划失败，他有一个退出方案。
words.en: To have a way to escape from a commitment or responsibility.

words.tr: phrase. 有点疯疯癫癫的；头脑不正常；异想天开
words.ex: He talks nonsense all the time; I think he has bats in his belfry.
words.ex_cn: 他总是说胡话，我觉得他脑子有问题。
words.en: to be crazy or eccentric

words.tr: 短语动词. 问心无愧；未参与不正当行为；清白无辜
words.ex: He has clean hands after washing them.
words.ex_cn: 他洗完手后，手是干净的。
words.en: To be innocent or not involved in wrongdoing.

words.tr: phrase. 必须做某事；不得不做某事
words.ex: I have got to do my homework now.
words.ex_cn: 我现在必须做作业。
words.en: If you say that you have got to do something, you mean that you must do it.

words.tr: phrase. 在各方面都优于；比……强得多
words.ex: He has it all over me when it comes to cooking.
words.ex_cn: 说到做饭，他比我强多了。
words.en: To be far superior to someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 没有持久力；无法持续；缺乏耐力或维持能力
words.ex: This phone battery have no staying power.
words.ex_cn: 这个手机电池不耐用。
words.en: To lack the ability to endure or persist in a task, activity, or situation over time.

words.tr: 短语动词. 完全拒绝接受某事物；不容忍某事物
words.ex: I have none of his patience when it comes to waiting.
words.ex_cn: 当涉及到等待时，我一点也没有他的耐心。
words.en: To refuse to accept or tolerate something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 根本比不上；毫无优势；没有掌握某人的把柄
words.ex: I have nothing on tomorrow, so I can help you.
words.ex_cn: 我明天没有任何安排，所以可以帮你。
words.en: If you have nothing on someone, you have no evidence that they have committed a crime. If you say that one thing has nothing on another, you mean that the first thing is not nearly as good as the second.

words.tr: phrase. 如果可以自己选择的话；要是称心如意的话（= if one could choose）
words.ex: If I had my druthers, I would go to the beach every day.
words.ex_cn: 如果让我选择，我每天都会去海滩。
words.en: To have one's own preference or choice.

words.w: have one's hand in the till
words.tr: phrase. 把手伸进钱柜；贪污公款；挪用资金
words.uk: hæv wʌnz hænd ɪn ðə tɪl
words.us: hæv wʌnz hænd ɪn ðə tɪl
words.ex: He got fired because he was caught having his hand in the till.
words.ex_cn: 他被解雇了，因为他被发现挪用公款。
words.en: To steal money from the place where one works, especially by taking it directly from a cash register or safe.

words.tr: phrase. 受到限制而无法采取行动；无能为力
words.ex: The teacher has her hands tied because she must follow the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师必须遵守规定，所以她无能为力。
words.en: If you say that someone has their hands tied, you mean that they are not free to behave in the way that they might want to because something such as a rule or law prevents them.

words.w: have one's head in the clouds
words.tr: phrase. 心不在焉的；不切实际的；幻想过多的
words.uk: hæv wʌnz hed ɪn ðə klaʊdz
words.us: hæv wʌnz hɛd ɪn ðə klaʊdz
words.ex: He always daydreams in class; he has his head in the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 他上课总是在做白日梦；他总是心不在焉。
words.en: To be out of touch with reality or to daydream and not pay attention to what is happening around you.

words.w: have one's heart go out to sb.
words.tr: phrase. 对某人深感同情；衷心同情某人
words.uk: hæv wʌnz hɑːt ɡəʊ aʊt tuː sb
words.us: hæv wʌnz hɑːrt ɡoʊ aʊt tuː sb
words.ex: I have my heart go out to the lost children.
words.ex_cn: 我为那些迷路的孩子感到心疼。
words.en: If you have your heart go out to someone, you feel a lot of sympathy for them.

words.w: have one's heart in one's mouth
words.tr: phrase. 形容非常紧张或害怕，心脏仿佛跳到喉咙口
words.uk: hæv wʌnz hɑːt ɪn wʌnz maʊθ
words.us: hæv wʌnz hɑːrt ɪn wʌnz maʊθ
words.ex: I had my heart in my mouth when the dog ran towards me.
words.ex_cn: 当那只狗向我跑来时，我吓得心都提到嗓子眼了。
words.en: To be extremely nervous or frightened.

words.tr: phrase. （心脏）停跳一拍；节奏中断；犹豫或停顿一下；通常用于否定句表示“毫不迟疑”
words.ex: He didn't miss a beat when he started singing after the break.
words.ex_cn: 他在休息后开始唱歌时没有错过一个节拍。
words.en: To fail to keep up with the rhythm or pace; to hesitate or falter.

words.w: have one's heart skip a beat
words.tr: phrase. 心跳漏了一拍；突然感到紧张、惊讶或兴奋
words.uk: hæv wʌnz hɑːt skɪp ə biːt
words.us: hæv wʌnz hɑːrt skɪp ə bit
words.ex: The loud noise made my heart skip a beat.
words.ex_cn: 那声巨响让我心跳加速。
words.en: To suddenly feel very excited, nervous, or frightened, often because of love or surprise.

words.w: have one's heart set against sth.
words.tr: phrase. 决心反对某事；打定主意不赞成某事
words.uk: hæv wʌnz hɑːt set əˈɡenst ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: hæv wʌnz hɑːrt set əˈɡenst ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He has his heart set against moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他坚决反对搬去新城市。
words.en: To be firmly opposed to something.

words.tr: phrase. 心脏仿佛停止跳动，形容极度恐惧或紧张
words.ex: When I saw the snake, my heart stood still.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到那条蛇时，我的心跳都停止了。
words.en: To feel extremely frightened or shocked.

words.tr: phrase. （俚语）受到严厉惩罚或责骂；被人狠狠教训
words.ex: If you lose this game, they will have your hide.
words.ex_cn: 如果你输了这场比赛，他们会狠狠收拾你。
words.en: To punish or deal with someone severely.

words.w: have one's tail between one's legs
words.tr: phrase. 形容某人因羞愧、害怕或失败而显得垂头丧气、狼狈不堪的样子
words.uk: hæv wʌnz teɪl bɪˈtwiːn wʌnz leɡz
words.us: hæv wʌnz teɪl bɪˈtwin wʌnz leɡz
words.ex: After losing the game, he walked away with his tail between his legs.
words.ex_cn: 比赛输了后，他垂头丧气地走开了。
words.en: To feel ashamed or defeated.

words.tr: phrase. 形容某人在紧张或危险情况下保持冷静和机智，能够迅速做出正确判断；头脑清醒，随机应变
words.ex: He must have his wits about him when crossing the busy street.
words.ex_cn: 他过繁忙的街道时必须保持清醒。
words.en: To remain alert and think quickly in a challenging or dangerous situation.

words.tr: phrase. 保持头脑冷静；随时保持警觉；对某人保持机敏
words.ex: He kept his wits about him when the car skidded on ice.
words.ex_cn: 当汽车在冰上打滑时，他保持了清醒。
words.en: To remain calm and think clearly in a difficult or dangerous situation.

words.w: have one's words stick in one's throat
words.tr: phrase. 因紧张、恐惧或情绪激动而说不出话来；话卡在喉咙里说不出来
words.uk: hæv wʌnz wɜːdz stɪk ɪn wʌnz θrəʊt
words.us: hæv wʌnz wɜːrdz stɪk ɪn wʌnz θroʊt
words.ex: He wanted to say sorry, but his words stuck in his throat.
words.ex_cn: 他想说对不起，但话卡在喉咙里说不出来。
words.en: To be unable to speak because of strong emotions, especially fear or nervousness.

words.tr: 短语动词. 使自己拥有某物；让自己享受某事物
words.ex: He had himself a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他给自己买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: To obtain or secure something for oneself.

words.tr: 有理由做某事
words.ex: He has reason to be happy.
words.ex_cn: 他有理由感到高兴。
words.en: If you have reason to do something, you have a good cause or justification for doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 有理由；有原因
words.ex: I have reason to believe he is telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 我有理由相信他说的是实话。
words.en: To have a basis or justification for a belief, action, or feeling.

words.tr: phrase. 头脑糊涂；愚蠢；固执
words.ex: He wants to jump off a bridge to save a toy. He must have rocks in his head.
words.ex_cn: 他想跳下桥去救一个玩具。他一定是脑子有病。
words.en: If you say that someone has rocks in their head, you mean that they are very stupid or that they have done something very stupid.

words.tr: phrase. 完全掌握某人犯罪或犯错的证据；使某人无法抵赖
words.ex: The police have him dead to rights for stealing the car.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓到他偷车，证据确凿。
words.en: To have someone dead to rights means to have conclusive evidence of someone's guilt, leaving no doubt about their involvement in a crime.

words.tr: phrase. v. 完全控制某人；使某人听从自己摆布
words.uk: hæv sʌm wʌn ɪn wʌnz ˈpɒkɪt
words.us: hæv sʌm wʌn ɪn wʌnz ˈpɑːkɪt
words.ex: He has the mayor in his pocket, so he can get anything he wants from the city government.
words.ex_cn: 他完全控制了市长，所以可以从市政府得到他想要的任何东西。
words.en: To have someone in one's pocket means to have complete control or influence over them, often used in a context where one person can manipulate another's actions or decisions.

words.tr: 短语动词，表示某人正在处理或负责某事，掌握着某种情况或事物
words.ex: I have the book in my hands.
words.ex_cn: 我手里拿着这本书。
words.en: To be in control of a situation or to have the responsibility for something.

words.tr: phrase. 把…交托给某人处理；交由某人全权负责
words.ex: He left the problem in her hands.
words.ex_cn: 他把问题留给了她处理。
words.en: To entrust someone with the responsibility or care of something.

words.tr: phrase. 把……交到某人手中；把……交由某人负责；让某人掌控
words.ex: I put the decision in his hands.
words.ex_cn: 我把决定权交给了他。
words.en: To give someone the responsibility or control of something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 带着……一起；随身领着……
words.ex: He always has his little brother in tow when he goes to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他去公园时总是带着他的小弟弟。
words.en: To have someone or something following or accompanying you, often in a way that is noticeable or requires your attention.

words.tr: phrase. 穿着；戴着；计划要做
words.ex: She has on a red dress.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着一件红裙子。
words.en: To wear something; to be wearing something. Also, to deceive someone or to have something arranged.

words.tr: phrase. 有事要做；有事情要处理
words.ex: I have something to do this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我有些事情要做。
words.en: If you say that one thing has something to do with another, you mean that the two things are connected in some way.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对某人掌握不利证据或秘密；在某人身上发现把柄；拥有能用来对付他人的信息
words.ex: I can't make it tonight, I already have something on.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚不行，我已经有安排了。
words.en: To be busy with a planned activity or event.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有值得称道之处；有吸引人的优点（常指某人具备某种优势或魅力）
words.ex: She really has something going for her with her new job.
words.ex_cn: 她的新工作确实对她很有吸引力。
words.en: If someone or something has something going for them, they have a particular advantage or asset that makes them likely to succeed or be popular.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有某种进展；在进行某事；指某人正在从事或拥有某种正在发展的状况或关系
words.ex: They have something going on between them, but they're not telling anyone.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间有些什么正在进行，但他们没有告诉任何人。
words.en: If you have something going, you are involved in a particular activity or relationship, often one that is secret or not fully disclosed.

words.tr: 短语动词. 与某人有某种关系（通常指恋爱或暧昧关系）
words.ex: She suspects that her husband has something going with his colleague.
words.ex_cn: 她怀疑她丈夫和他的同事之间有某种关系。
words.en: To be involved in a romantic relationship with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 与……有关；和……有关系
words.ex: This problem has something to do with math.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数学有关。
words.en: To be connected with or relevant to something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 与……有共同之处；和……有相似的地方
words.ex: They have something in common with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此之间有一些共同之处。
words.en: To share similar interests, experiences, or characteristics with someone or something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有共同之处；有共同点
words.ex: They have something in common because they both enjoy hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他们有共同点，因为他们都喜欢徒步旅行。
words.en: To share similar interests, characteristics, or experiences with someone else.

words.tr: 短语动词. 已经着手处理某事；控制或管理某事
words.ex: I have the report in hand and will submit it by the end of the day.
words.ex_cn: 我手头有这份报告，并将在今天结束前提交。
words.en: To have something under one's control or in one's possession.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有现货；备有某物
words.ex: The shop has some red apples in stock.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店有红苹果存货。
words.en: If a shop has something in stock, it has that item available to buy.

words.tr: phrase. 还剩下一些东西；仍有剩余
words.ex: I have some money left after buying lunch.
words.ex_cn: 买完午饭后我还剩一些钱。
words.en: To still possess or retain something after some has been used or taken away.

words.tr: phrase. 使某物被制作（通常指委托他人制作）
words.ex: I had a suit made for the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 我为婚礼定制了一套西装。
words.en: To have something completed or ready.

words.tr: 短语动词. 将某物存档；保留某物的记录
words.ex: We have your resume on file for future job openings.
words.ex_cn: 我们已将你的简历存档，以备将来招聘之用。
words.en: To have something recorded or stored in a file for future reference.

words.tr: 短语动词. 聪明能干；有真才实学；办事有效率
words.ex: He has something on the ball and solves problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很有能力，能快速解决问题。
words.en: To possess a significant amount of ability, skill, or talent in a particular area.

words.tr: phrase. 一心想着某事；满脑子都是某事
words.ex: Ever since he saw that car, he's had it on the brain.
words.ex_cn: 自从他看到了那辆车，他就一直念念不忘。
words.en: If you have something on the brain, you can't stop thinking or talking about it.

words.w: have sth. stick in one's craw
words.tr: phrase. v. 某事让人感到极度不满或难以接受，梗在心头
words.uk: hæv ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈstɪk ɪn wʌnz krɔː
words.us: hæv ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈstɪk ɪn wʌnz krɔː
words.ex: The unfair treatment really had something sticking in his craw.
words.ex_cn: 不公平的待遇真的让他难以接受。
words.en: To be difficult for someone to accept or digest.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有富余的东西；有多余的（时间、金钱、物品等）可以分享或给予他人
words.ex: Do you have something to spare for the homeless man?
words.ex_cn: 你有什么可以 spare 给那个无家可归的人吗？
words.en: To have more of something than is needed or used.

words.tr: phrase. 手痒偷东西；有偷窃的习惯
words.ex: Be careful, he has sticky fingers and might take your pen.
words.ex_cn: 小心，他手不干净，可能会拿走你的笔。
words.en: If someone has sticky fingers, they have a tendency to steal things.

words.tr: 短语动词. 比某人有优势；在某方面胜过某人
words.ex: She has the advantage of him in terms of experience.
words.ex_cn: 她在经验方面比他更有优势。
words.en: To be in a better position than someone else, especially in a competition or conflict.

words.tr: 短语动词. 比某人有优势；在某方面胜过某人
words.ex: She has an advantage over her competitors because of her extensive experience.
words.ex_cn: 由于她丰富的经验，她比竞争对手更有优势。
words.en: To have a better position or opportunity compared to someone else.

words.tr: 短语动词. 比某人有优势；在与某人的比较中处于有利地位
words.ex: She has the advantage over her opponent in terms of experience.
words.ex_cn: 她在经验方面比对手占优势。
words.en: To be in a better position than someone else, especially in a competition or contest.

words.w: have the courage of one's convictions
words.tr: phrase. 有勇气坚持自己的信念；敢于按自己的信念行事
words.ex: He has the courage of his convictions and speaks the truth, even when it is hard.
words.ex_cn: 他有坚持自己信念的勇气，即使困难也说真话。
words.en: To have the courage of one's convictions means to be brave enough to do what you believe to be right, even though other people may not agree or approve.

words.tr: 短语动词. 具有某种感觉或氛围；让人感觉到某事物的存在或特质
words.ex: The room has the feel of a cozy home.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有家的温馨感觉。
words.en: To give the impression or sensation of being a particular thing.

words.tr: phrase. 有口才；能说会道；善于言辞
words.ex: He has the gift of gab and can talk to anyone easily.
words.ex_cn: 他天生善于言辞，能轻松地和任何人交谈。
words.en: To have the ability to speak easily and confidently in a way that makes people want to listen to you.

words.tr: n. 通行权；（交通上的）优先权
words.ex: The pedestrian has the right-of-way at the crosswalk.
words.ex_cn: 行人在人行横道上有优先通行权。
words.en: The legal right, established by usage or grant, to pass along a specific route through grounds or property belonging to another.

words.w: have the time of one's life
words.tr: 短语动词. 过得最愉快的时光；玩得非常开心
words.uk: hæv ðə taɪm əv wʌn z laɪf
words.us: hæv ði taɪm əv wʌn z laɪf
words.ex: They had the time of their lives at the beach party.
words.ex_cn: 他们在海滩派对上玩得非常开心。
words.en: To enjoy oneself very much; to have a very good time.

words.w: have the wherewithal to do sth.
words.tr: 短语动词. 有做某事所需的财力或其他资源；有能力做某事
words.uk: hæv ðə ˈwɛəwɪðɔːl tuː duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: hæv ðə ˈwɛrɪwɪðɔːl tuː duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: She has the wherewithal to start her own business.
words.ex_cn: 她有足够的资源开始自己的生意。
words.en: To have the necessary means, especially financial means, to do something.

words.tr: n. 必要的资金
words.ex: He lacked the wherewithal to start his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他缺乏创业所需的资金。
words.en: The necessary means, especially financial means, to accomplish something.

words.w: have them rolling in the aisles
words.tr: phrase. 形容某人或某事非常有趣，让人笑得前仰后合，捧腹大笑
words.uk: hæv ðəm ˈrəʊlɪŋ ɪn ði aɪlz
words.us: hæv ðəm ˈroʊlɪŋ ɪn ði aɪlz
words.ex: His jokes have them rolling in the aisles.
words.ex_cn: 他的笑话让他们笑得前仰后合。
words.en: To cause someone to laugh uncontrollably.

words.tr: phrase. 必须接受某事；不得不忍受某事
words.ex: You will have to live with the consequences of your actions.
words.ex_cn: 你将不得不接受你行为的后果。
words.en: To accept something unpleasant or undesirable because there is no other choice.

chapters.name: 第一部分 LESSON 10 基本动词 HOLD

words.tr: phrase. 掌握所有优势；处于有利地位
words.ex: He holds all the aces in this deal, so he can ask for more.
words.ex_cn: 他在这笔交易中占尽优势，所以可以要求更多。
words.en: To be in a very strong position in a competition or conflict, with all the advantages.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；持有；容纳；保留；举行；
n. 拿；控制；持；
words.ex: He held the rope tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧抓住了绳子。
words.en: To have or keep in the hand; to maintain in a grasp; to keep in a specified state, relation, or position; to contain or be capable of containing; to have in one's possession; to keep back from action; to delay the action or effect of; to keep in custody; to bear, sustain, or support; to have or maintain in the mind; to consider or esteem; to assert or affirm; to organize and carry on; to have the ownership or use of; to keep from falling or moving; to remain unbroken or unyielding; to remain attached or faithful; to remain valid or effective.

words.tr: phrase. 不支持；不为……辩护；对……不负责任（通常用于表示对某人或某事没有特别的同情或支持）
words.ex: I hold no brief for him, so I can see his mistakes clearly.
words.ex_cn: 我并不支持他，所以我能清楚地看到他的错误。
words.en: To not support or approve of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. v. 推迟做某事；暂缓做某事
words.ex: They decided to hold off doing something until the weather improved.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定等到天气好转再做某事。
words.en: To delay doing something, especially until a more suitable time.

words.tr: phrase. v. 推迟；阻挡；抑制；保持距离
words.ex: Please hold off until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请等到明天再做。
words.en: To delay doing something, or to prevent something from happening or someone from doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 抓紧不放；继续；不挂断；坚持
words.ex: Hold on the rope tightly!
words.ex_cn: 紧紧抓住绳子！
words.en: To continue to do something or to wait for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 屏气；屏息
words.ex: He holds his breath when he waits for the result.
words.ex_cn: 他等待结果时屏住呼吸。
words.en: If you hold your breath, you make yourself stop breathing for a moment, usually because you are waiting for something to happen.

words.w: hold one's end of the bargain up
words.tr: phrase. 坚守协议的一方义务；履行自己在协议或约定中的承诺
words.uk: həʊld wʌnz end əv ðə ˈbɑːɡɪn ʌp
words.us: hoʊld wʌnz end əv ðə ˈbɑːrɡən ʌp
words.ex: He holds his end of the bargain up by paying on time every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月准时付款，履行了自己的协议义务。
words.en: To fulfill one's part of an agreement or deal.

words.w: hold up one's end of the bargain
words.tr: phrase. v. 履行协议中自己应尽的部分；承担自己在协议或约定中的责任
words.uk: /həʊld ʌp wʌnz end ɒv ðə ˈbɑːɡɪn/
words.us: /hoʊld ʌp wʌnz end ʌv ðə ˈbɑːrɡɪn/
words.ex: He did not hold up his end of the bargain, so they stopped working together.
words.ex_cn: 他没有履行自己的协议义务，所以他们停止了合作。
words.en: To fulfill one's part of an agreement or deal.

words.tr: phrase. v. 抬头挺胸；昂首；自豪地面对
words.ex: After passing the test, he can hold his head up again.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试后，他可以重新昂首挺胸了。
words.en: To maintain one's dignity or self-respect in the face of difficulties or criticism.

words.tr: phrase. 抬起头；昂首挺胸；感到自豪
words.ex: After passing the test, he could hold up his head with pride.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试后，他可以自豪地昂起头。
words.en: To maintain one's dignity or pride, especially in the face of adversity.

words.tr: phrase. v. 坚持自己的立场；不输给他人；能自立
words.ex: In the debate, she held her own against older students.
words.ex_cn: 在辩论中，她面对年长的学生也毫不示弱。
words.en: To maintain one's position or condition without being overwhelmed or defeated.

words.tr: phrase. 忍住不说；保持沉默；不发表意见
words.ex: He held his tongue during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间保持沉默。
words.en: To refrain from speaking or expressing an opinion, especially when it might be wise or polite to do so.

words.tr: phrase. v. 坚持要求；拒不接受妥协；等待更好的条件或结果
words.ex: He held out for a better job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持等待更好的工作机会。
words.en: To refuse to accept anything less than what you have asked for or hoped for.

words.tr: phrase. 伸出；提供；坚持；抵抗；寄予（希望）
words.ex: He held out his hand to help her up.
words.ex_cn: 他伸出手帮她起来。
words.en: If you hold out your hand or something you have in your hand, you move your hand away from your body, usually to offer something to someone else.

words.tr: 短语动词. 主动示好，伸出橄榄枝（表示愿意和解或结束争执）
words.ex: After the long dispute, the company finally decided to hold out the olive branch to their competitors.
words.ex_cn: 在长期的争议之后，公司最终决定向竞争对手伸出橄榄枝。
words.en: To offer reconciliation or peace; to make an offer of peace or reconciliation.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对某人因某事追究责任；要求某人对某事负责
words.ex: The manager decided to hold the employee accountable for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 经理决定让员工对错误负责。
words.en: To consider someone responsible for something; to blame or credit someone for something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对某人追究责任；要求某人对自己的行为负责
words.ex: We need to hold the company accountable for its environmental practices.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要让公司为其环境行为承担责任。
words.en: To consider someone responsible for something, especially in a position of authority.

words.tr: phrase. 比喻性地指利用某事威胁或控制某人，尤指以揭露秘密或过错相要挟
words.ex: He's always holding his past mistakes over her head, making her feel guilty.
words.ex_cn: 他总是用她过去的错误来要挟她，让她感到内疚。
words.en: To use something as a threat or leverage against someone.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；支撑；继续下去；推举；阻挡；拦截；持械抢劫
words.ex: He held up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To hold something up means to keep it in a high position so that it does not fall or to support it. It can also mean to delay or stop the progress of something or someone, or to rob someone using violence or the threat of violence.

words.tr: phrase. 把……树立为榜样；把……作为例子来推崇
words.ex: Teachers hold her up as an example because she works hard.
words.ex_cn: 老师把她当作榜样，因为她很努力。
words.en: To praise or cite someone or something as a model to be imitated.

words.tr: phrase. v. 因某事责怪或记恨某人；因某人的过错而对其产生负面看法
words.ex: Don't hold it against him if he can't make it to your party.
words.ex_cn: v. 如果他不能参加你的派对，不要因此对他怀恨在心。
words.en: To continue to blame or feel angry towards someone for something they have done.

words.tr: phrase. 看守岗位；暂时维持局面（尤指在他人离开时代为照看）
words.ex: While the manager was away, I had to hold the fort.
words.ex_cn: 经理不在的时候，我得负责管理。
words.en: To take care of a place, thing, or situation while someone is absent.

words.tr: 短语动词. 坚持立场；维持现状；不妥协；（电话中）请勿挂断
words.ex: Please hold the line while I transfer your call.
words.ex_cn: 请稍等，我为您转接电话。
words.en: To keep a telephone connection open; to maintain a position or opinion despite pressure.

words.tr: phrase. 别着急；稍等片刻；冷静下来（常用于劝人耐心等待）
words.ex: Hold your horses, we need to wait for the others.
words.ex_cn: 不要着急，我们需要等其他人。
words.en: Used to tell someone to wait and not be so impatient.

chapters.name: 第一部分 基本动词HOLD补充词组

words.tr: phrase. 举行会议
words.ex: They will hold a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将召开会议。
words.en: To organize and conduct a formal gathering of people for discussion or decision-making.

words.tr: phrase. v. 高谈阔论；滔滔不绝地讲话
words.ex: He likes to hold forth on his travels in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢大谈他在山里的旅行经历。
words.en: To speak at length or in detail about a particular subject, often in a way that is intended to impress or persuade others.

words.tr: 短语动词. 忍住不采取行动；暂不发表意见；按兵不动
words.ex: The teacher told the students to hold their fire and wait for the signal.
words.ex_cn: 老师告诉学生们先别行动，等信号再开始。
words.en: To refrain from shooting or taking action, especially in a military or argumentative context, in order to wait for a more opportune moment or to avoid causing harm.

words.tr: phrase. 保持沉默；不发表意见；缄口不言
words.ex: He decided to hold his peace during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他决定在会议上保持沉默。
words.en: To refrain from speaking or to keep silent, especially in order to avoid causing trouble or conflict.

words.tr: phrase. 伸出；提供；坚持；抵抗；寄予（希望）
words.ex: He held out his hand to help her up.
words.ex_cn: 他伸出手帮她起来。
words.en: If you hold out your hand or something you have in your hand, you move your hand away from your body, usually to offer something to someone else.

words.tr: phrase. v. 抑制某人；压制某人；阻止某人发展或成功
words.ex: The oppressive regime tried to hold the people down.
words.ex_cn: 压迫政权试图压制人民。
words.en: To prevent someone from advancing or achieving their potential.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 控制某人；压制某人；使某人无法自由行动或发展
words.ex: He managed to hold down the job for two years.
words.ex_cn: 他设法保住了这份工作两年。
words.en: to keep someone or something under control or to prevent them from increasing

words.tr: phrase. v. 延期；延长（会议、假期等）；继续保留
words.ex: They decided to hold over the meeting until next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定将会议推迟到下周。
words.en: To postpone or delay something; to continue to use, show, or do something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 紧紧抓住；坚持住；耐心等待
words.ex: Hold tight to the railing as you climb the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 上楼梯时牢牢抓住扶手。
words.en: To hold something firmly and not let go, or to remain in a particular state or position without moving or changing.

words.tr: 短语动词. 紧紧抓住；坚持住
words.ex: Hold on tight to the railing as you walk down the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 下楼梯时紧紧抓住扶手。
words.en: To grip something firmly and securely with one's hands or arms.

chapters.name: 第一部分 LESSON 11 基本动词 KEEP

words.tr: phrase. 保持沉着冷静；咬紧牙关；不动声色；强忍悲伤或痛苦
words.ex: Despite the challenges, she managed to keep a stiff upper lip.
words.ex_cn: 尽管面临挑战，她还是设法保持了坚毅的态度。
words.en: To remain resolute and unemotional in the face of adversity.

words.tr: 短语动词. 表示在困难或痛苦时保持冷静、克制情绪，不轻易表露感情，尤指英国人传统的坚忍态度
words.ex: Despite the crisis, he managed to have a stiff upper lip.
words.ex_cn: 尽管面临危机，他仍然设法保持镇定。
words.en: If you say that someone has a stiff upper lip, you mean that they do not show their feelings when they are upset, even though it is difficult for them not to.

words.tr: phrase. 板着脸；忍住不笑；保持严肃的表情
words.ex: Despite the ridiculous situation, she managed to keep a straight face.
words.ex_cn: 尽管情况很荒谬，她还是设法保持了面无表情。
words.en: To keep a straight face means to manage not to show any emotion, especially when you are trying not to laugh.

words.tr: 短语动词. 能保持严肃的表情，不笑出来
words.ex: She tried to have a straight face while telling the joke, but couldn't help laughing.
words.ex_cn: 她在讲笑话时试图板着脸，但还是忍不住笑了。
words.en: To maintain a serious expression without showing any emotion, especially when telling a joke or saying something that might be expected to provoke laughter.

words.tr: phrase. 与…保持同步；及时了解；跟上…的最新发展
words.ex: It's important to keep abreast of the latest developments in technology.
words.ex_cn: 跟上科技的最新发展是很重要的。
words.en: To keep abreast of something means to stay informed about new developments in a particular subject or situation.

words.tr: adv. 并肩；并列
words.ex: They walked abreast down the street.
words.ex_cn: 他们并肩走在街上。
words.en: If people or things are abreast, they are lined up next to each other, side by side, and often facing the same direction.

words.tr: phrase. 与…保持同步；跟上（最新发展）；不落后于
words.ex: To keep abreast of the latest developments in technology, you need to constantly update your knowledge.
words.ex_cn: 为了跟上技术领域的最新发展，你需要不断更新你的知识。
words.en: To keep abreast of something means to stay informed about new developments or changes in a particular subject or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持做某事；持续不断地干某事
words.ex: Keep at your studies, and you will succeed.
words.ex_cn: 坚持你的学习，你就会成功。
words.en: To continue doing something persistently or diligently.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人交往；陪伴某人；与某人为伴
words.ex: She likes to keep company with people who share her interests.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢与志趣相投的人交往。
words.en: To spend time with someone, especially in a way that shows you are friends.

words.tr: phrase. 保持冷静；保持镇定；保持凉爽
words.ex: He keeps cool when the fire alarm sounds.
words.ex_cn: 当火警响起时，他保持冷静。
words.en: To remain calm and composed, especially in a stressful situation.

words.tr: phrase. 料理家务；管理家务；当家
words.ex: She keeps house for her family every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天为家人操持家务。
words.en: To manage the household; to take care of the domestic chores.

words.tr: phrase. 熬夜；晚睡晚起；作息很晚
words.ex: He keeps late hours because he works at night.
words.ex_cn: 他因为晚上工作而熬夜。
words.en: To stay up late at night, especially regularly.

words.tr: phrase. 继续做某事；持续不断地做某事
words.ex: Keep on practicing every day, and you will get better.
words.ex_cn: 每天坚持练习，你会进步的。
words.en: To continue doing something without stopping.

words.tr: phrase. 继续
words.ex: He keeps on walking even when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 即使累了，他还是继续走。
words.en: If you keep on doing something, you continue to do it and do not stop.

words.tr: phrase. 振作起来；不气馁；保持乐观
words.ex: Keep your chin up, things will get better soon.
words.ex_cn: 振作起来，情况很快就会好起来的。
words.en: To remain cheerful in a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 与…保持距离；疏远；避免接近
words.ex: It's wise to keep one's distance from wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 与野生动物保持距离是明智的。
words.en: To stay at a distance from someone or something, either physically or emotionally, to avoid getting too close or involved.

words.tr: phrase. 祈求好运；为…祈祷成功；交叉手指以求好运
words.ex: I keep my fingers crossed for you in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 我为你的考试顺利通过而祈祷。
words.en: To hope for a positive outcome for someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 祈求好运；交叉手指以求好运；祝愿一切顺利
words.ex: I'm keeping my fingers crossed for good weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我祈求明天天气好。
words.en: To hope that something will happen in the way that you want it to.

words.tr: phrase. 对…保持沉默；绝口不提…
words.ex: He saw the mistake but decided to keep his mouth shut about it.
words.ex_cn: 他看到了错误，但决定对此保持沉默。
words.en: To refrain from speaking or revealing information about something, especially something that is secret or confidential.

words.tr: phrase. 保持沉默；守口如瓶；闭嘴不说
words.ex: He told me a secret, so I will keep my mouth shut.
words.ex_cn: 他告诉了我一个秘密，所以我不会说出去。
words.en: To keep one's mouth shut means to not reveal secret information or to remain silent about something that one knows but should not tell others.

words.tr: phrase. 保持清白；不惹麻烦；行为检点
words.ex: He tries to keep his nose clean at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校努力表现良好。
words.en: To avoid trouble or involvement in illegal activities.

words.tr: phrase. 遵守诺言；守信用
words.ex: He keeps his word and always does what he promises.
words.ex_cn: 他信守诺言，总是做他承诺过的事情。
words.en: To do what one has promised to do.

words.tr: phrase. 与…并驾齐驱；与…同步；跟上…的步伐
words.ex: He works hard to keep pace with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以跟上同学的步伐。
words.en: To maintain the same speed or progress as something else.

words.tr: phrase. 跟上；与…并驾齐驱；保持同步
words.ex: She needs to keep pace with the fast-moving market.
words.ex_cn: 她需要跟上快速变化的市场。
words.en: To move or progress at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 陪伴某人；与某人作伴
words.ex: She stayed late at the office to keep him company.
words.ex_cn: v. 她留在办公室陪伴他。
words.en: to stay with someone so that they are not alone

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；妨碍；抑制
words.ex: The heavy rain kept us from going out.
words.ex_cn: 大雨阻止了我们外出。
words.en: To prevent someone from doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人守规矩；约束某人；让某人服从规定
words.ex: The teacher has to work hard to keep the students in line.
words.ex_cn: 老师必须努力工作以使学生们遵守规则。
words.en: To ensure that someone behaves in a way that is acceptable or follows the rules.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人处于焦虑不安的等待中；让某人提心吊胆
words.ex: The suspense of the movie kept the audience on tenterhooks.
words.ex_cn: 电影的悬念让观众提心吊胆。
words.en: To keep someone in a state of anxious suspense or uncertainty.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人处于紧张不安或焦虑等待的状态
words.ex: The suspense of the movie had the audience on tenterhooks.
words.ex_cn: 电影的悬念让观众如坐针毡。
words.en: To keep someone in a state of anxious suspense or uncertainty.

words.tr: phrase. 使…无法近身；遏制；阻止…发展
words.ex: They kept the cold at bay with warm clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他们用暖和的衣服把寒冷挡在外面。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from approaching or having an effect.

words.tr: phrase. 把……挡开；使……无法接近；暂时控制住（危险、困难等）
words.ex: They held the enemy at bay with strong defense.
words.ex_cn: 他们用强有力的防守将敌人击退。
words.en: To keep someone or something at a distance or prevent them from causing harm or trouble.

words.tr: phrase. 使无法靠近；牵制；阻止；遏制
words.ex: They keep the cold at bay with warm clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他们用暖和的衣服把寒冷挡在外面。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from approaching or affecting you.

words.tr: phrase. 抑制；控制；使…处于受控状态
words.ex: We must keep our spending in check.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须控制我们的开支。
words.en: To keep something in check means to control it and prevent it from becoming too great or causing problems.

words.tr: phrase. 抑制；控制；使……处于受控状态
words.ex: He holds his anger in check during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间控制着自己的愤怒。
words.en: To control or restrain something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 谨记，牢记
words.ex: Keep this rule in mind when you write essays.
words.ex_cn: 当你写文章时，要记住这个规则。
words.en: If you keep something in mind, you remember it and take it into account in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 记住；牢记
words.ex: Bear in mind that the bus leaves at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 请记住，公交车晚上6点发车。
words.en: If you tell someone to bear something in mind, you are reminding or warning them about something important which they should remember.

words.tr: phrase. 不许入内； 挡在外面
words.ex: The fence is to keep out animals.
words.ex_cn: 这道篱笆是用来挡动物的。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from entering a place.

words.tr: phrase. 坚持；继续；跟上
words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To continue to do something; to maintain something at a high level; to stay level or equal with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 随时向某人通报最新情况；让某人随时了解进展
words.ex: Please keep me posted on any new developments.
words.ex_cn: 请随时向我汇报任何新的进展。
words.en: To inform someone regularly about the latest news or developments.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事保密；不告诉别人；独自保留
words.ex: He kept the secret to himself.
words.ex_cn: 他把秘密藏在心里。
words.en: To not tell anyone else about something.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事保密；把某事藏在心里
words.ex: He decided to keep the news under his hat until the official announcement.
words.ex_cn: 他决定在官方宣布之前对这个消息保密。
words.en: To keep something secret or not to tell anyone about something.

words.tr: phrase. 将某事保密；使某事不公开
words.ex: The company is keeping the details of the new project under wraps until the official announcement.
words.ex_cn: 公司在新项目正式宣布前一直对其细节保密。
words.en: To keep something secret or hidden, especially until a planned time.

words.tr: phrase. 密切留意；监视；随时掌握……的动态
words.ex: He keeps tabs on his friend's schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都会关注朋友的日程安排。
words.en: To keep tabs on something or someone means to keep a careful watch on them or to monitor them closely.

words.tr: phrase. 跟上...的进展；记录
words.ex: I keep track of my expenses every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天记录我的开支。
words.en: To keep track of something means to stay informed about it or to record it, especially in order to notice any changes or developments.

words.tr: phrase. 维持家庭温暖与正常运转；在家人外出时操持家务并传递关怀；在后方给予支持与鼓励
words.ex: She keeps the home fires burning while her husband works abroad.
words.ex_cn: 当她丈夫在国外工作时，她在家维持着家庭的温暖。
words.en: To maintain the normal functioning of home or family life, especially during a period of absence or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 保守秘密；控制局势；压制某事使其不外泄
words.ex: The government tried to keep the lid on the scandal.
words.ex_cn: 政府试图压制这个丑闻。
words.en: To prevent something from becoming worse or getting out of control.

words.w: keep the wolf from the door
words.tr: phrase. 勉强度日；勉强维持生计；避免挨饿受穷
words.uk: kiːp ðə wʊlf frəm ðə dɔː
words.us: kiːp ðə wʊlf frəm ðə dɔːr
words.ex: He took on a second job to keep the wolf from the door.
words.ex_cn: 他接了一份兼职工作以勉强维持生计。
words.en: To have enough money to be able to buy the things that you need in order to live, especially food and shelter.

words.tr: phrase. 不交际；保密秘密
words.ex: He likes to keep to himself and doesn't talk much.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢独来独往，不太说话。
words.en: To remain private or secret; to not share one's thoughts or feelings with others.

words.tr: phrase. 跟上
words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To keep up with something means to manage to do or have as much of it as is necessary or desirable, or to move at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 继续装模作样；维持假象；一直假装
words.ex: She tried to keep up an act of being happy when she was actually very sad.
words.ex_cn: 她试图装出一副开心的样子，其实她非常难过。
words.en: To continue to pretend to be something that one is not, especially in order to deceive others.

words.tr: phrase. 维持某人的伪装；继续装模作样；保持表面上的表现
words.ex: He keeps up his act to make everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他持续表演来逗 everyone 开心。
words.en: To continue to behave or perform in a particular way, especially to deceive others.

words.tr: phrase. （在物质或社会地位上）与邻居或他人攀比；赶时髦
words.ex: They buy a new car every year just to keep up with the Joneses.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年买一辆新车，只是为了和邻居攀比。
words.en: To strive to match or surpass one's neighbors or peers in terms of material possessions or social status.

words.tr: phrase. 跟上时代；与时俱进
words.ex: To stay competitive, companies must keep up with the times and adopt new technologies.
words.ex_cn: 为了保持竞争力，公司必须与时俱进，采用新技术。
words.en: To keep up with the times means to stay informed about or adapt to current trends, developments, or fashions.

words.tr: phrase. 使事情继续进行；保持势头
words.ex: We need to keep the ball rolling on this project.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要让这个项目继续进行下去。
words.en: To keep an activity or conversation going.

words.tr: phrase. 保持冷静；别着急；别发火
words.ex: Keep your shirt on, we'll get there eventually.
words.ex_cn: 保持冷静，我们最终会到达那里的。
words.en: to remain calm and not become angry or upset

words.tr: phrase. 别着急；保持冷静；稍安勿躁
words.ex: Keep your pants on, I'll be ready in a minute.
words.ex_cn: 耐心等一下，我马上就好。
words.en: Used to tell someone to be patient and not to hurry or get excited.

chapters.name: 第一部分 基本动词KEEP补充词组

words.w: keep a civil tongue in one's head
words.tr: phrase. 说话有礼貌；说话客气；保持文明用语
words.uk: kiːp ə ˈsɪvl tʌŋ ɪn wʌnz hed
words.us: kiːp ə ˈsɪvəl tʌŋ ɪn wʌnz hed
words.ex: He told me to keep a civil tongue in my head when I argued with my friend.
words.ex_cn: 当我跟朋友争吵时，他告诉我得说话客气点。
words.en: To speak politely and avoid saying anything offensive or rude.

words.w: have a civil tongue in one's head
words.tr: phrase. 指说话有礼貌、得体，懂得用文明的语言与人交流
words.uk: hæv ə ˈsɪvɪl tʌŋ ɪn wʌnz hed
words.us: hæv ə ˈsɪvəl tʌŋ ɪn wʌnz hɛd
words.ex: It's important to have a civil tongue in one's head when dealing with customers.
words.ex_cn: 与客户打交道时，说话客气是很重要的。
words.en: To speak politely and courteously.

words.tr: phrase. 说话有礼貌；保持言语文明
words.ex: He tried to keep a civil tongue during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中努力保持礼貌的言辞。
words.en: To speak politely and without causing offense.

words.tr: phrase. 记录某事；对某事进行账目或情况的记载
words.ex: She keeps an account of all her expenses.
words.ex_cn: 她记录下自己所有的开销。
words.en: To record or monitor something, such as expenses or events.

words.tr: phrase. 勉强维持生计；仅能糊口
words.ex: He works two jobs to keep body and soul together.
words.ex_cn: 他做两份工作来维持生计。
words.en: To have enough money to buy the things that are necessary to live.

words.tr: phrase. （钟表）走时准确；计时精准
words.ex: My old watch still keeps good time.
words.ex_cn: 我的旧手表仍然走得准。
words.en: To maintain accurate timekeeping.

words.tr: phrase. 避开某物；不接触某物；远离某物
words.ex: Please keep off the grass.
words.ex_cn: 请不要踩草坪。
words.en: To avoid or stay away from something, especially a topic or substance.

words.tr: phrase. 让开；不接近
words.ex: Keep off the grass.
words.ex_cn: 别踩草坪。
words.en: To avoid touching, stepping on, or coming into contact with something; to prevent someone or something from coming near or touching something.

words.tr: phrase. 继续做某事；坚持进行某事
words.ex: Despite the difficulties, she decided to keep on with her studies.
words.ex_cn: 尽管困难重重，她决定继续她的学业。
words.en: To continue doing something, especially when it is difficult or when there are problems.

words.tr: phrase. 继续
words.ex: He keeps on walking even when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 即使累了，他还是继续走。
words.en: If you keep on doing something, you continue to do it and do not stop.

words.w: keep one's eye on the ball
words.tr: phrase. 保持专注；紧盯目标；集中精力
words.uk: kiːp wʌnz aɪ ɒn ðə bɔːl
words.us: kiːp wʌnz aɪ ɑːn ðə bɔːl
words.ex: You must keep your eye on the ball if you want to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 如果你想赢得比赛，就必须集中注意力。
words.en: To keep one's eye on the ball means to remain focused on the most important aspect of a situation or task, not allowing oneself to be distracted by less important matters.

words.tr: phrase. 留意；密切注意；留心寻找
words.ex: I keep my eyes open for good books at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上留意好的书。
words.en: To be on the lookout for something; to pay attention in order to find or notice something.

words.tr: phrase. 保持警觉；密切留意；睁大眼睛寻找……
words.ex: Keep your eyes peeled for the red car.
words.ex_cn: 留意那辆红色的汽车。
words.en: To remain vigilant or watchful for something.

words.tr: phrase. 保持警惕；睁大眼睛留意；密切注意
words.ex: You should keep your eyes open when walking in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 在黑暗中行走时，你应该睁大眼睛。
words.en: To remain vigilant or alert to what is happening around you, especially in order to notice any opportunities or dangers.

words.tr: phrase. 保持警觉；擦亮眼睛；密切留意
words.ex: Keep your eyes peeled for the red car.
words.ex_cn: 留意那辆红色的汽车。
words.en: To keep one's eyes peeled means to stay alert and watch carefully for something.

words.tr: phrase. 继续参与某事；保持对某事的熟悉或熟练；保持对某事的掌控
words.ex: He keeps his hand in the family business by attending meetings.
words.ex_cn: 他通过参加会议保持对家族企业的参与。
words.en: To continue to be involved in or practice something, especially to maintain a skill or stay informed about a particular area.

words.tr: phrase. 保持熟练；继续参与（某活动）以维持技能
words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend to keep his hand in.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末都打网球，以保持手感。
words.en: To continue to practice a skill or activity so that one does not lose the ability to do it well.

words.tr: phrase. 保守秘密；不透露自己的想法；保持沉默
words.ex: He keeps his own counsel and never tells others his plans.
words.ex_cn: 他保守自己的想法，从不告诉别人他的计划。
words.en: to keep one's thoughts, plans, or opinions to oneself; not to share them with others

words.tr: phrase. 保持冷静；克制脾气；不发脾气
words.ex: He tries to keep his temper when the children are noisy.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子们吵闹时，他尽量不发脾气。
words.en: To maintain one's composure and not become angry, especially in a challenging or provocative situation.

words.tr: phrase. 控制住自己的脾气；不发怒
words.ex: He tries to hold his temper when his brother takes his toys.
words.ex_cn: 当他的弟弟拿走他的玩具时，他尽量不发脾气。
words.en: To keep one's temper means to stay calm and not get angry, even in a situation that might normally provoke anger.

words.tr: phrase. 保持警觉；密切留意；时刻提防
words.ex: You should keep your weather eye open for mistakes in the test.
words.ex_cn: 你应该密切关注考试中的错误。
words.en: To remain vigilant and watchful, especially in situations where one needs to be cautious or aware of potential dangers.

words.tr: phrase. 避开某事；不卷入某事；远离某事
words.ex: Try to keep out of their arguments.
words.ex_cn: 尽量不介入他们的争论。
words.en: To remain uninvolved in something; to stay away from something.

words.tr: phrase. 避开某事；不参与某事；不卷入某事
words.ex: It's better to stay out of their family disputes.
words.ex_cn: 最好不要参与他们的家庭纷争。
words.en: If you stay out of something, you do not get involved in it.

words.tr: phrase. 不许入内； 挡在外面
words.ex: The fence is to keep out animals.
words.ex_cn: 这道篱笆是用来挡动物的。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from entering a place.

words.tr: phrase. 留在外面；不进入；避免参与
words.ex: The children must stay out until the rain stops.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们必须留在外面，直到雨停。
words.en: To remain away from home or a particular place, especially at night.

words.tr: phrase. 对…保持沉默；对…守口如瓶；不透露关于…的信息
words.ex: She decided to keep quiet about the incident to avoid unnecessary drama.
words.ex_cn: 她决定对这件事保持沉默，以避免不必要的戏剧性事件。
words.en: To not talk about something, especially something that might be a secret or that someone wants to keep private.

words.tr: phrase. 保持静止；保持不动；别动
words.ex: Keep still while I take your photo.
words.ex_cn: 我给你拍照时别动。
words.en: To remain in the same position without moving.

words.tr: phrase. 保持安静；默不作声；保密
words.ex: Please keep quiet during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 请在电影放映期间保持肃静。
words.en: To remain silent or make little noise.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人笑个不停；让某人捧腹大笑
words.ex: His funny stories kept us in stitches all night.
words.ex_cn: 他有趣的故事让我们整晚捧腹大笑。
words.en: To make someone laugh uncontrollably.

words.tr: phrase. 让某人笑得前仰后合；使某人极度发笑
words.ex: His jokes had the audience in stitches.
words.ex_cn: 他的笑话让观众笑得前仰后合。
words.en: To make someone laugh uncontrollably.

words.tr: phrase. 与…保持距离；疏远；不亲近
words.ex: He keeps his phone at a distance when he sleeps.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉时把手机放在远处。
words.en: To maintain a certain space or emotional detachment from someone or something, often to avoid getting too involved or affected.

words.tr: phrase. ph. 保持距离；避免过分亲密
words.ex: He keeps his neighbors at arm's length.
words.ex_cn: 他与邻居保持距离。
words.en: To avoid becoming too close or involved with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；隐瞒；留在后面
words.ex: He tried to keep back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To retain or withhold something, not allowing it to be seen, known, or used.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；使退缩；隐瞒
words.ex: He tried to hold back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To hold back means to prevent someone or something from moving forward or making progress, or to keep something secret or not express your feelings.

words.tr: phrase. 保持节拍；计时；守时；准确地计时
words.ex: The old clock cannot keep time well.
words.ex_cn: 这个旧钟不能很好地保持准确时间。
words.en: To keep time is to maintain a regular rhythm or pace, especially in music or in measuring time.

words.tr: phrase. 密切注视；监视
words.ex: The guard keeps watch on the gate at night.
words.ex_cn: 警卫晚上守着大门。
words.en: To keep watch on something or someone means to observe them carefully in order to notice any signs of danger or unusual activity.

words.tr: phrase. 守望；放哨；监视；保持警惕
words.ex: They decided to keep watch over the house during the night.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定在晚上看守房子。
words.en: To keep watch means to stay in a place in order to guard someone or something or to look out for danger.

words.tr: phrase. 看守；监视；照管；守护
words.ex: The dog keeps watch over the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗晚上看守着房子。
words.en: To keep watch over something or someone means to stay alert and pay attention to them, often to protect them or to ensure that they do not do anything wrong.

chapters.name: 第一部分 LESSON 12 基本动词 LOOK

words.tr: phrase. 照料；照顾
words.ex: She looks after her little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To take care of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 照顾；照看；照料
words.ex: She promised to see after the children while their parents were away.
words.ex_cn: 她承诺在孩子们的父母不在时照顾他们。
words.en: To take care of someone or something; to attend to the needs of someone or something.

words.w: look as if butter wouldn't melt in one's mouth
words.tr: phrase. 看起来天真无辜、温顺乖巧（实际上可能并非如此）
words.uk: lʊk æz ɪf ˈbʌtə wədnt ˈmelt ɪn wʌnz maʊθ
words.us: lʊk æz ɪf ˈbʌtər wədnt ˈmelt ɪn wʌnz maʊθ
words.ex: He looks as if butter wouldn't melt in his mouth, but he is very clever.
words.ex_cn: 他看起来天真无邪，但实际上很聪明。
words.en: To appear to be very innocent, gentle, or naive, often in a way that is deceptive.

words.tr: phrase. 斜着眼看某人；用不满或怀疑的眼神看某人
words.ex: She didn't like the way he looked at her cross-eyed.
words.ex_cn: 她不喜欢他那样对她怒目而视。
words.en: To glance at someone with a skeptical or critical look, often implying doubt or disapproval.

words.tr: phrase. 斜着眼看某人；怒视某人；对某人表示不满或怀疑
words.ex: She looked cross-eyed at him when he mentioned the money he owed.
words.ex_cn: 当他提到他欠的钱时，她斜眼看他。
words.en: To look at someone with a disapproving or suspicious expression.

words.tr: phrase. 回顾；回想；追忆（过去的事情）
words.ex: I look back on my childhood with happiness.
words.ex_cn: 我满怀幸福地回忆我的童年。
words.en: To think about something that happened in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 对某人怒目而视；用充满敌意的眼神瞪着某人
words.ex: She looked daggers at him when he mentioned her ex-boyfriend.
words.ex_cn: 当他提到她的前男友时，她对他怒目而视。
words.en: To look at someone with a very angry expression.

words.tr: phrase. 蔑视；瞧不起
words.ex: He looks down on people who work hard.
words.ex_cn: 他瞧不起努力工作的人。
words.en: To regard someone or something as inferior or unworthy of respect.

words.tr: phrase. 轻视；看不起；对…嗤之以鼻
words.ex: He looks down his nose at people who don't go to college.
words.ex_cn: 他瞧不起那些没有上过大学的人。
words.en: To regard someone or something with disdain or scorn.

words.tr: phrase. 寻找
words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 到处寻找……；四处搜寻……；翻遍各处寻找
words.ex: He looked for his keys high and low.
words.ex_cn: 他到处寻找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search everywhere for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 到处寻找；四处搜寻
words.ex: He looked high and low for his lost keys.
words.ex_cn: 他到处寻找他丢失的钥匙。
words.en: To search everywhere for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 自找麻烦；寻衅；惹事生非
words.ex: He always looks for trouble when he goes to parties.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加派对时总是找麻烦。
words.en: To behave in a way that is likely to cause problems or a dangerous situation.

words.tr: phrase. 期待某事；盼望某事
words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.tr: phrase. 顺便看望；顺道探视
words.ex: She decided to look in on her grandmother after work.
words.ex_cn: 她决定下班后去看看她的祖母。
words.en: To visit someone briefly, especially to see if they are all right or if they need anything.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 查看；探望；检查（某人或某情况）以确保一切正常
words.ex: She makes a point to check in on her elderly neighbors regularly.
words.ex_cn: 她特意定期去探望她的老年邻居。
words.en: To visit or contact someone in order to find out about their health or to see how they are doing.

words.tr: phrase. 看望
words.ex: I will look in on my grandma after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后会去看望我奶奶。
words.en: To make a brief visit or inspection.

words.tr: phrase. 登记；报到
words.ex: He checks in at the hotel at 3 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他在下午三点办理入住。
words.en: To announce your arrival, especially at a hotel or an airport, by signing your name or showing your ticket.

words.tr: phrase. 调查；研究；观察；检查
words.ex: The police will look into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查这起事故。
words.en: If you look into a problem or matter, you investigate it or examine it.

words.tr: phrase. 看穿某事；洞察某事的真相或本质
words.ex: She could see into his true intentions.
words.ex_cn: 她能看透他的真实意图。
words.en: To investigate or understand something thoroughly.

words.tr: phrase. 调查某事；登记入住某处
words.ex: We will check into something if we see a problem.
words.ex_cn: 如果我们发现问题，就会去调查一下。
words.en: To register one's arrival at a hotel, airport, etc., or to investigate or look into something.

words.tr: phrase. 看起来光彩照人；显得非常漂亮；看上去棒极了
words.ex: You look like a million dollars in that dress!
words.ex_cn: 你穿那条裙子看起来美极了！
words.en: To appear very attractive or prosperous.

words.tr: phrase. 看上去棒极了；显得光彩照人；看起来非常漂亮
words.ex: You look like a million bucks in that dress!
words.ex_cn: 你穿那条裙子看起来美极了！
words.en: To look extremely attractive or successful.

words.w: look like the cat that swallowed the canary
words.tr: phrase. 显得洋洋得意；一副做了坏事却暗自窃喜的样子；像偷了腥的猫一样得意
words.uk: lʊk laɪk ðə kæt ðæt ˈswɒləʊd ðə kəˈneəri
words.us: lʊk laɪk ðə kæt ðæt ˈswɑːloʊd ðə kəˈneri
words.ex: He looks like the cat that swallowed the canary after winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得比赛后，看起来得意极了。
words.en: To appear very self-satisfied or pleased with oneself, often in a way that is obvious to others.

words.w: look like the cat who swallowed the canary
words.tr: phrase. 看起来像一只刚吞下金丝雀的猫；形容人得意洋洋、沾沾自喜、一副做了坏事却暗自窃喜的样子
words.uk: lʊk laɪk ðə kæt huː ˈswɒləʊd ðə kəˈneəri
words.us: lʊk laɪk ðə kæt huː ˈswɑloʊd ðə kəˈneri
words.ex: He looks like the cat who swallowed the canary after winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得比赛后，看起来就像那只吞了金丝雀的猫。
words.en: To appear very self-satisfied or smug, often because of having done something clever or secretive.

words.tr: phrase. 观看；面向；旁观；看待
words.ex: They look on while the children play.
words.ex_cn: 他们看着孩子们玩耍。
words.en: To watch something happen without getting involved.

words.tr: phrase. 旁观某事；袖手旁观某事
words.ex: He stood there, looking on at the game.
words.ex_cn: 他站在那里，观看比赛。
words.en: To watch an event or situation without taking part in it.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人看作/视为某人；认为某人是……
words.ex: She looked on him as a brother.
words.ex_cn: 她把他看作是自己的兄弟。
words.en: To consider or regard someone in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 直视某人的眼睛；坦然无惧地正视某人
words.ex: He couldn't look her in the eye after lying to her.
words.ex_cn: 对她撒谎后，他无法正视她的眼睛。
words.en: To look directly into someone's eyes, especially as a way of showing that you are honest or brave.

words.tr: phrase. 直视某人的脸；正视某人；坦然地看着某人
words.ex: He couldn't look her in the face after what he had done.
words.ex_cn: 做了那件事之后，他无法直视她的脸。
words.en: To look directly at someone without avoiding their gaze, often implying honesty, challenge, or confrontation.

words.tr: phrase. （某事）显而易见，明摆着（某人却视而不见）
words.ex: The solution to the problem stared him in the face, but he didn't see it.
words.ex_cn: 问题的解决办法就在他眼前，但他却没有看到。
words.en: If something is staring you in the face, it is very obvious but you may not notice it immediately.

words.tr: phrase. 察看；检查；翻阅；原谅；从...上面看
words.ex: He will look over his homework before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉前会检查一下作业。
words.en: To examine or inspect something quickly or casually.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；查找；向上看
words.ex: I look up the word in the dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在字典里查这个词。
words.en: If you look up a fact or a piece of information, you find it by looking in something such as a reference book or a list.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 找到；搜寻并找到（某物或某人）
words.ex: He will hunt up his old books in the attic.
words.ex_cn: 他将在阁楼里寻找他的旧书。
words.en: To search for something that is difficult to find.

words.tr: phrase. 尊敬某人；仰慕某人
words.ex: Children need role models to look up to.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们需要仰望的榜样。
words.en: To admire or respect someone, often because they have achieved a lot or they have particular qualities.

chapters.name: 第一部分 基本动词LOOK补充词组

words.tr: phrase. 看起来像
words.ex: He looks like his father.
words.ex_cn: 他看起来像他的父亲。
words.en: To resemble or seem similar to someone or something in appearance.

chapters.name: 第一部分 LESSON 13 基本动词 MAKE

words.tr: phrase. 径直走向；直奔；迅速而直接地朝…而去
words.ex: When the rain started, we made a beeline for the car.
words.ex_cn: 下雨时，我们径直跑向汽车。
words.en: To go directly and quickly towards someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 向某处猛冲；突然逃向某处；奋力冲向某物
words.ex: The thief made a break for the door when he saw the police.
words.ex_cn: 小偷看到警察时，他向门口逃跑。
words.en: If you make a break for a place, you try to escape or run towards it suddenly.

words.tr: phrase. 赚大钱；发大财
words.ex: He made a bundle selling old toys online.
words.ex_cn: 他通过在网上卖旧玩具赚了一大笔钱。
words.en: To earn a large amount of money.

words.tr: phrase. 发财；赚大钱；积累大量财富
words.ex: He make a pile of books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他在桌子上堆起了一堆书。
words.en: To earn a large amount of money.

words.w: make a clean breast of sth.
words.tr: phrase. 彻底坦白（某事）；把（某事）和盘托出
words.uk: meɪk ə kliːn brest əv ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: meɪk ə kliːn brest əv ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He decided to make a clean breast of the whole affair to the police.
words.ex_cn: 他决定向警方彻底坦白整个事件。
words.en: To confess something fully and frankly.

words.w: make a clean sweep of sth.
words.tr: phrase. 彻底清除某物；大获全胜；一举全部拿下
words.uk: meɪk ə kliːn swiːp əv ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: meɪk ə kliːn swiːp əv ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: The team made a clean sweep of all the awards at the competition.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍在比赛中赢得了所有奖项。
words.en: To completely remove or change something, especially in order to start afresh.

words.tr: phrase. 彻底清扫；大获全胜；一举清除
words.ex: The new manager decided to make a clean sweep and replace the entire team.
words.ex_cn: 新经理决定彻底清除并更换整个团队。
words.en: To completely remove or eliminate something, or to win all possible prizes or awards.

words.tr: phrase. 东山再起；复出；重新流行
words.ex: After years away, the singer will make a comeback next month.
words.ex_cn: 离开多年后，这位歌手将于下个月复出。
words.en: To return to a former position of strength, importance, or high rank after a period of absence.

words.tr: phrase. 在…上取得初步进展；使…有所减少；对…产生初步影响
words.ex: We need to make a dent in our workload today.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天需要在工作量上取得一些进展。
words.en: To make a dent in something means to make some progress in dealing with a large task or to reduce the amount of something by a small but noticeable amount.

words.tr: phrase. 迅速赚钱；捞一笔快钱；不择手段地快速牟利
words.ex: He's always looking for ways to make a fast buck.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在寻找快速赚钱的方法。
words.en: To earn money quickly and often easily, sometimes in a way that is considered unethical or illegal.

words.tr: phrase. 迅速赚一笔钱；轻松捞快钱
words.ex: He's always looking for ways to make a quick buck.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在寻找快速赚钱的方法。
words.en: To make money quickly and often with little effort.

words.w: make a federal case out of sth.
words.tr: phrase. 对某事小题大做；把某事当成天大的事
words.uk: meɪk ə ˈfedərəl keɪs aʊt əv ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: meɪk ə ˈfedərəl keɪs aʊt əv ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He made a federal case out of the missing pen, calling for a full investigation.
words.ex_cn: 他对丢失的笔小题大做，要求进行全面调查。
words.en: To exaggerate the importance of something, often a minor issue, and treat it as if it were a major problem that requires a lot of attention and resources.

words.w: make a big deal about sth.
words.tr: phrase. 对某事小题大做；对某事过分重视或大惊小怪
words.uk: meɪk ə bɪɡ diːl əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: meɪk ə bɪɡ diːl əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: She tends to make a big deal about small problems.
words.ex_cn: 她往往对小问题小题大做。
words.en: To treat something as if it is very important or serious, especially when it is not.

words.tr: phrase. 对…大惊小怪；过分关心；小题大做
words.ex: They make a fuss over their dog every time he comes home.
words.ex_cn: 每次他们的狗回家时，他们都会对它大惊小怪一番。
words.en: To pay excessive attention to someone or something, often in a way that is unnecessary or overprotective.

words.tr: phrase. 努力尝试；设法成功；把某事做成
words.ex: They were determined to make a go of it, despite the challenges.
words.ex_cn: 尽管面临挑战，他们决心要获得成功。
words.en: To attempt to achieve success in a particular endeavor or activity.

words.w: make a great show of sth.
words.tr: phrase. 对某事大肆张扬；装腔作势地做某事；故意表现出对某事的重视
words.uk: meɪk ə ɡreɪt ʃəʊ əv sθ
words.us: meɪk ə ɡreɪt ʃoʊ əv sθ
words.ex: He made a great show of his wealth by driving a luxury car.
words.ex_cn: 他开着豪车大肆炫耀自己的财富。
words.en: To make a great show of something means to display or demonstrate it in a very obvious or exaggerated way, often to impress others or to make a point.

words.tr: phrase. 受到……的欢迎；给……留下深刻印象；大获成功
words.ex: The new song will make a hit with young people.
words.ex_cn: 这首新歌会受到年轻人的欢迎。
words.en: To be very successful or popular with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 大获成功；受到好评
words.ex: The new song made a hit on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 这首新歌在广播上大受欢迎。
words.en: To achieve success or popularity, especially in entertainment or media.

words.tr: phrase. 突然大赚一笔；发大财；获取暴利
words.ex: He made a killing selling old phones online.
words.ex_cn: 他通过在网上卖旧手机大赚了一笔。
words.en: To make a lot of money quickly, especially by doing something that involves taking a risk.

words.tr: phrase. 谋生
words.ex: He makes a living by selling vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他靠卖蔬菜谋生。
words.en: To earn enough money to support oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 长话短说；简而言之；概括地说
words.ex: To make a long story short, we ended up getting married.
words.ex_cn: 长话短说，我们最终结婚了。
words.en: To summarize a story or explanation briefly.

words.tr: phrase. 把某事弄糟；把某事搞得一团糟
words.ex: He made a mess of the presentation by forgetting his notes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为忘了带笔记，把演讲搞得一团糟。
words.en: To do something badly or inefficiently, resulting in a chaotic or unsatisfactory situation.

words.tr: phrase. 弄乱；搞糟；弄得一团糟
words.ex: The children make a mess with their toys every day.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天都把玩具弄得一团糟。
words.en: To make a mess means to create disorder or confusion by making things untidy or disorganized.

words.w: make a mountain out of a molehill
words.tr: phrase. 小题大做；把小事夸大成严重问题
words.uk: meɪk ə ˈmaʊntɪn aʊt əv ə ˈməʊlhɪl
words.us: meɪk ə ˈmaʊntn aʊt əv ə ˈmoʊlhɪl
words.ex: She tends to make a mountain out of a molehill, blowing small issues out of proportion.
words.ex_cn: 她倾向于小题大做，把小问题夸大。
words.en: To exaggerate a minor problem or issue to make it seem much more important or serious than it really is.

words.tr: phrase. 成名；为自己赢得名声；出人头地
words.ex: He worked hard to make a name for himself as a singer.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，想作为歌手出名。
words.en: To become famous or well-known for something.

words.tr: phrase. 成名；树立名声；赢得声誉
words.ex: He wants to make a name as a singer.
words.ex_cn: 他想作为一名歌手出名。
words.en: To become famous or well-known for something.

words.tr: phrase. 向某人调情；对某人示爱；向某人挑逗
words.ex: He tried to make a pass at her at the party, but she politely declined.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上试图对她献殷勤，但她礼貌地拒绝了。
words.en: To make a romantic or sexual advance towards someone.

words.tr: phrase. 为…做推销；为…说好话；极力争取；向…提出请求
words.ex: He made a pitch for more time to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他请求更多时间来完成项目。
words.en: To try to persuade someone to do or accept something.

words.tr: phrase. 推销；进行推销；做宣传；游说
words.ex: He will make a pitch for the new project tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将为新项目做一次推介。
words.en: To make a persuasive attempt to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 试图得到；设法争取；向…示好；对…展开追求
words.ex: He made a play for the ball during the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中试图抢球。
words.en: To attempt to obtain or achieve something, often in a competitive or strategic manner.

words.tr: phrase. 采取行动；试图获得；试图赢得；在比赛中做出进攻尝试
words.ex: He will make a play for the ball during the game.
words.ex_cn: 他会在比赛中抢球。
words.en: To try to attract someone's romantic interest.

words.tr: phrase. 提出观点；表明看法；特意做某事以强调
words.ex: He made a point to finish his homework early.
words.ex_cn: 他特意早点完成作业。
words.en: To make a point means to express an idea or opinion clearly and directly, often in a way that is intended to persuade others or to emphasize the importance of something.

words.w: make a point of doing sth.
words.tr: phrase. 特意做某事；认为做某事很重要；总是坚持做某事
words.uk: meɪk ə pɔɪnt əv ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: meɪk ə pɔɪnt əv ˈduɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: She made a point of thanking everyone who helped her.
words.ex_cn: 她特意感谢了每一个帮助过她的人。
words.en: If you make a point of doing something, you do it in a very deliberate and obvious way, often because you think it is important.

words.tr: phrase. 养成做某事的习惯；经常性地做某事
words.ex: She made a practice of jogging every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她养成了每天早上慢跑的习惯。
words.en: To do something regularly or habitually.

words.tr: phrase. 使某事成为惯例；把某事作为常规做法
words.ex: He made it a practice to exercise every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他养成每天早上锻炼的习惯。
words.en: To make something a regular or habitual action.

words.tr: phrase. 赶紧逃跑；迅速逃离；撒腿就跑
words.ex: He decided to make a run for it when he saw the police approaching.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到警察走近时，他决定逃跑。
words.en: If you make a run for it, you try to escape from a place by running.

words.tr: phrase. 当众大吵大闹；大吵大嚷；引起骚动
words.ex: He started to make a scene when he heard the bad news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到坏消息时，他大吵大闹起来。
words.en: If someone makes a scene, they behave in a loud, angry, or emotional way that causes a lot of trouble or embarrassment.

words.tr: 短语动词. 大吵大闹；惹是生非；引起骚动
words.ex: The artist will create a scene with trees and a river.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家将创作一幅有树木和河流的景象。
words.en: To cause a public disturbance or draw attention to oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到；体谅；为…留有余地
words.ex: The teacher makes allowance for students who are late because of traffic.
words.ex_cn: 老师会考虑到因交通堵塞而迟到的学生。
words.en: To take into consideration when making a judgment or decision.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到；体谅；为…留有余地；为…作让步
words.ex: We need to make allowance for the fact that he is still new to the job.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要考虑到他还是新手的这个事实。
words.en: To consider or take into account something when making a decision or judgment, especially in order to be fair or to make up for a particular condition or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 露面；出席；出现；公开亮相
words.ex: He will make an appearance at the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚会出现在聚会上。
words.en: To come into sight or to be present at an event or function.

words.tr: phrase. 拿某人开刀；惩戒某人以儆效尤
words.ex: The teacher decided to make an example of the student who was caught cheating.
words.ex_cn: 老师决定惩罚那个被抓到作弊的学生以儆效尤。
words.en: To punish someone as a warning to others.

words.tr: phrase. 为某人破例；对某人给予特殊照顾
words.ex: The company usually doesn't allow pets, but they made an exception for the employee who has a service dog.
words.ex_cn: 公司通常不允许宠物，但他们为那位有服务犬的员工破例了。
words.en: To allow someone not to follow the usual rule or principle.

words.tr: phrase. 破例；例外
words.ex: He made an exception for his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他为他妹妹破了例。
words.en: To allow someone or something to be treated differently from the usual rule.

words.tr: phrase. 给某人留下印象；使某人产生深刻印象
words.ex: He wore a nice suit to make an impression on his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套好西装给老板留下好印象。
words.en: To cause someone to notice and admire you.

words.tr: phrase. 给人留下印象；产生影响
words.ex: He wants to make an impression on his new teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他想给新老师留下印象。
words.en: To cause someone to notice and remember you because of your actions, appearance, or words.

words.tr: phrase. 开玩笑；说俏皮话；挖苦；嘲讽
words.ex: He likes to make cracks about the weather during meetings.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在会议期间对天气开些玩笑。
words.en: To make jokes, especially at someone's expense.

words.tr: phrase. 拿…开玩笑；取笑；对…说风凉话
words.ex: He likes to make cracks about my hat.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢拿我的帽子开玩笑。
words.en: To make jokes or humorous remarks about someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 设法应付
words.ex: We don't have enough food, so we will make do with what we have.
words.ex_cn: 我们没有足够的食物，所以只能将就着用现有的。
words.en: If you make do with something, you use or have it instead of something else that you do not have, although it is not as good.

words.tr: phrase. 将就；凑合用；设法应付
words.ex: They had to make do with the old furniture until they could afford new ones.
words.ex_cn: 他们不得不凑合着用旧家具，直到能买得起新的。
words.en: If you make do with something, you use or have it instead of something else that you do not have, although it is not as good.

words.tr: phrase. 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计；量入为出
words.ex: He works two jobs to make ends meet.
words.ex_cn: 他做两份工作来维持生计。
words.en: To have enough money to pay for the things that you need.

words.tr: phrase. 使收支相抵；勉强维持生计；量入为出
words.ex: He works two jobs to make both ends meet.
words.ex_cn: 他做两份工作来维持收支平衡。
words.en: To have enough money to pay for the things that you need.

words.tr: phrase. 取笑
words.ex: They make fun of him for wearing old shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他穿旧鞋子而取笑他。
words.en: To tease, laugh at, or joke about someone in a way that is either playful or mocking.

words.tr: phrase. 取笑；拿…开玩笑；嘲弄
words.ex: They make fun of him because he wears old clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他们取笑他，因为他穿旧衣服。
words.en: To make fun of someone or something means to laugh at them or make jokes about them in a way that is not kind.

words.tr: phrase. 兑现（诺言、承诺等）；履行；偿还（债务）
words.ex: He promised to make good on his debt by the end of the month.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺在月底前偿还债务。
words.en: To fulfill or carry out a promise, obligation, or debt.

words.tr: phrase. 赚大钱；收入颇丰；挣很多钱
words.ex: He makes good money as a taxi driver.
words.ex_cn: 他当出租车司机赚了不少钱。
words.en: To earn a significant amount of money.

words.tr: phrase. （旅途中）进展迅速；比预期更快地抵达
words.ex: We made good time on the trip because there was no traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们一路上交通顺畅，所以很快就到了。
words.en: To travel a distance in a shorter time than expected or usual.

words.w: make hay while the sun is shining
words.tr: phrase. 趁热打铁；抓紧时机；趁晴晒草
words.uk: meɪk heɪ waɪl ðə sʌn ɪz ˈʃaɪnɪŋ
words.us: meɪk heɪ waɪl ðə sʌn ɪz ˈʃaɪnɪŋ
words.ex: He is working hard to finish the project, because he knows you must make hay while the sun is shining.
words.ex_cn: 他正在努力完成这个项目，因为他知道要趁热打铁。
words.en: To take advantage of a favorable situation or opportunity while it is available.

words.tr: phrase. 轻视某事；对某事轻描淡写；把某事不当回事
words.ex: He makes light of his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他轻视自己的错误。
words.en: To treat something as if it is not serious or important.

words.tr: phrase. 轻视；贬低；不放在眼里；对…不重视
words.ex: He made little of his success, saying it was just luck.
words.ex_cn: 他轻描淡写自己的成功，说那只是运气。
words.en: To treat something as unimportant or to minimize its significance.

words.tr: phrase. 毫不掩饰；直截了当；坦率地说
words.ex: He makes no bones about it when he says he loves chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 他毫不隐瞒自己爱吃巧克力。
words.en: To say or do something in a very direct and honest way, without trying to hide anything.

words.tr: phrase. 对某人没有影响；对某人来说无所谓
words.ex: It makes no difference to him if we leave early.
words.ex_cn: 我们早走对他来说无所谓。
words.en: To have no effect on someone's opinion or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 没有影响；都一样
words.ex: It makes no difference to me whether we eat now or later.
words.ex_cn: 我们是现在吃还是待会儿吃，对我来说都一样。
words.en: If something makes no difference, it does not change the situation or the outcome in any way.

words.tr: phrase. 毫无疑问；别搞错了；务必明确
words.ex: Make no mistake about it, he is the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 别搞错了，他是队里最好的球员。
words.en: Used to emphasize that what you are saying is true and that people should understand it as such.

words.tr: phrase. 毫无疑问；务必明确；别搞错了
words.ex: Make no mistake, this is the most important decision of your life.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 不要误会，这是你一生中最重要的决定。
words.en: Used to emphasize that what you are saying is true, especially when you think someone might think it is not true.

words.tr: phrase. 不把它当回事；认为无关紧要；别客气（用于回应感谢）
words.ex: He made nothing of the mistake and just kept working.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个错误没在意，继续工作。
words.en: To not consider something as important or to not pay attention to something.

words.tr: phrase. 请随意；别拘束；像在自己家一样
words.ex: Please make yourself at home and sit on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 请随便一点，坐在沙发上。
words.en: To behave as if you are in your own home, especially by relaxing and being comfortable.

words.tr: phrase. 决定某人成败；对某人起决定性作用
words.ex: This exam will make or break her.
words.ex_cn: 这次考试将决定她的成败。
words.en: To cause someone to either succeed or fail.

words.tr: adj. 不成则败的；孤注一掷的
words.ex: This exam is make-or-break for her future.
words.ex_cn: 这次考试对她的未来至关重要。
words.en: A make-or-break situation is one that will bring great success or complete failure.

words.tr: phrase. 赢得某人的好感；博取某人的认可；给某人留下好印象
words.ex: He tries to make points with his boss by arriving early.
words.ex_cn: 他通过早到来讨好老板。
words.en: To do something that causes someone to admire or respect you.

words.tr: phrase. 提出论点；阐述观点；得分；取得要点
words.ex: He tries to make points during the discussion.
words.ex_cn: 他在讨论中试图提出观点。
words.en: To score points in a game or argument.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；弄懂；从…中找出意义
words.ex: I can't make sense out of this math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂这个数学题。
words.en: To understand or find meaning in something, especially something that is complicated or not clear.

words.tr: phrase. 迅速完成某事；迅速解决某事；三下五除二地处理掉某事
words.ex: He made short work of the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: To deal with something quickly and efficiently.

words.tr: phrase. 迅速完成某事；三下五除二地搞定某事
words.ex: He made fast work of the math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他很快完成了数学作业。
words.en: To complete something very quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人认错；迫使某人收回前言并认错；让某人丢脸
words.ex: He lied about the mistake, but now he must make his boss eat crow.
words.ex_cn: 他谎称是别人的错，但现在他必须让老板认错。
words.en: to force someone to admit a mistake or accept a humiliating defeat

words.tr: phrase. 使某人显得出色；让某人看上去很棒
words.ex: Her help made me look good.
words.ex_cn: 她的帮助让我显得很出色。
words.en: To cause someone to appear attractive or impressive.

words.tr: phrase. 使…可供某人使用；向某人提供…；让某人可以获得…
words.ex: The school makes books available to students.
words.ex_cn: 学校向学生提供书籍。
words.en: To make something available to someone means to provide them with the opportunity to use or have it.

words.tr: phrase. 使……运转；使……正常运作；激发……的动机；让……有动力
words.ex: Love makes her heart tick.
words.ex_cn: 爱让她的心跳动。
words.en: To be the reason or motivation for something to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人火冒三丈
words.ex: It makes my blood boil when people are unfair to animals.
words.ex_cn: 当人们不公平地对待动物时，我就气得发疯。
words.en: To cause someone to become extremely angry.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人毛骨悚然；令某人极度恐惧
words.ex: The dark forest at night makes my blood run cold.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的黑暗森林让我毛骨悚然。
words.en: To cause someone to feel extreme fear or shock.

words.w: make one's hair stand on end
words.tr: phrase. 使某人毛骨悚然；使人极度惊恐
words.uk: meɪk wʌnz hɛə stænd ɒn end
words.us: meɪk wʌnz hɛr stænd ɒn end
words.ex: The ghost story made my hair stand on end.
words.ex_cn: 那个鬼故事吓得我毛骨悚然。
words.en: To cause someone to feel extremely frightened or horrified.

words.tr: phrase. 组成；构成；编造；弥补；和解；化妆
words.ex: He made up a story to explain why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 他编了个故事来解释为什么迟到。
words.en: To invent something, especially in order to deceive someone; to compensate for something lost, missed, or deficient; to form the whole of something; to apply cosmetics to oneself.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人成为替罪羊；把责任推给某人
words.ex: They made him the scapegoat for the team's failure.
words.ex_cn: 他们让他为团队的失败当替罪羊。
words.en: To make someone the scapegoat means to unfairly blame them for something bad that has happened, especially because you want to avoid blame or criticism yourself.

words.w: make sb. the scapegoat for sth.
words.tr: phrase. 使某人成为某事的替罪羊；把某事的责任推给某人
words.uk: meɪk ˈsʌmbədi ðə ˈskeɪpɡəʊt fə(r) ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: meɪk ˈsʌmbədi ðə ˈskeɪpɡoʊt fɔːr ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: They made him the scapegoat for the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他们让他为这场事故当替罪羊。
words.en: To make someone take the blame for something that is not their fault.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人头晕目眩；使人感到晕头转向或困惑
words.ex: The long math problem makes my head swim.
words.ex_cn: 这个长长的数学题让我头晕。
words.en: To cause someone to feel dizzy or confused, often due to a large amount of information or a complex situation.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人头晕目眩；令某人感到极度困惑或震惊
words.ex: Too many numbers on the screen make my head spin.
words.ex_cn: 屏幕上太多的数字让我头晕。
words.en: to cause someone to feel dizzy or confused, often because of too much information or too many things happening at once.

words.tr: phrase. 下定决心；作出决定
words.ex: He can't make his mind up about which book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他无法决定要读哪本书。
words.en: To decide something after thinking about it.

words.tr: phrase. 下决心；拿定主意
words.ex: He made up his mind to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他下定决心戒烟。
words.en: To decide something after considering it carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人垂涎；令人馋涎欲滴；让人非常想吃
words.ex: The smell of cookies makes my mouth water.
words.ex_cn: 饼干的香味让我的口水直流。
words.en: To cause someone to salivate or feel a strong desire for something, especially food.

words.tr: phrase. 阐明自己的立场；表明自己的态度
words.ex: He made his position clear at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上表明了自己的立场。
words.en: To express one's opinion or stance on a particular issue in a way that is understandable to others.

words.tr: phrase. 从零开始做某事；完全从头开始制作某物
words.ex: He made a cake from scratch.
words.ex_cn: 他从零开始做了一个蛋糕。
words.en: To create something from the beginning, without using anything that was already made.

words.tr: phrase. 补偿某人；向某人赔不是；弥补对某人造成的伤害或损失
words.ex: He forgot her birthday, so he bought her flowers to make it up to her.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了她的生日，所以买了花来弥补她。
words.en: To do something good for someone because you have done something bad to them or because they have been disappointed by you.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；辨认出；书写；进展；设法应付；亲热
words.ex: I can't make out the words in this small print.
words.ex_cn: 我看不清这些小字。
words.en: to manage to see, hear, or understand someone or something with difficulty

words.tr: phrase. 凭空捏造；无事生非；白手起家创造事物
words.ex: He made a toy out of nothing but old boxes.
words.ex_cn: 他只用旧纸箱就做了一个玩具。
words.en: To create something valuable or significant from very little or nothing.

words.tr: phrase. 按订单制作；定制某物；根据顾客要求制作某物
words.ex: He made a table to order for his new house.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的新房子定制了一张桌子。
words.en: To produce something according to the specific requirements or specifications of a customer.

words.tr: phrase. 充分利用某事；尽力把不利情况变为有利；善处逆境
words.ex: She decided to make the best of the situation and enjoy the trip despite the bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 她决定尽量利用这个情况，尽管天气不好，还是享受这次旅行。
words.en: To use or deal with something in a way that achieves as much as possible, especially in a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 引起激烈争吵；闹出大乱子；大打出手
words.ex: When the two cats fight, they really make the fur fly.
words.ex_cn: 当这两只猫打架时，它们真的让毛飞起来了。
words.en: To cause a lot of trouble or argument, especially by saying or doing something that makes people very angry.

words.tr: phrase. 引起激烈争吵；大吵大闹；使局势骤然紧张
words.ex: When he told the joke, he made the feathers fly.
words.ex_cn: 当他讲那个笑话时，引起了哄堂大笑。
words.en: To cause a disturbance or conflict.

words.tr: phrase. 引起骚动；激起尘土；干得热火朝天；大动干戈
words.ex: The horse ran fast and made the dust fly.
words.ex_cn: 那匹马跑得很快，扬起了尘土。
words.en: To cause dust to rise into the air; to create a disturbance or commotion.

words.tr: phrase. 达到标准；成功；合格
words.ex: He studied hard to make the grade in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，以便在数学课上达到标准。
words.en: To reach the required standard; to succeed.

words.tr: phrase. 充分利用某物；最大限度地利用某事；尽量发挥某事的价值
words.ex: You should make the most of your time while you're young.
words.ex_cn: 你应该趁着年轻充分利用时间。
words.en: To use or enjoy something as much as possible.

words.tr: phrase. 匆匆赶往；朝…疾行；动身前往
words.ex: We make tracks for the beach every summer.
words.ex_cn: 我们每年夏天都动身去海滩。
words.en: To go or move quickly towards a particular place.

words.tr: phrase. 赶紧离开；匆匆离去；开溜
words.ex: He made tracks when he saw the police.
words.ex_cn: 他一看到警察就赶紧走了。
words.en: To leave a place, especially quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 弥补失去的时间；把耽误的时间补回来
words.ex: He works hard to make up for lost time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作来弥补失去的时间。
words.en: To compensate for time that was wasted or unproductive.

words.tr: phrase. 弥补某事；补偿某事；为某事作出补偿
words.ex: He worked extra hours to make up for the lost time.
words.ex_cn: 他加班工作以弥补失去的时间。
words.en: To compensate for something that is lacking or has been lost.

words.tr: phrase. 与...重修旧好
words.ex: He tried to make up with his friend after the fight.
words.ex_cn: 他在吵架后试图与朋友和好。
words.en: To reconcile with someone after a disagreement or argument.

words.tr: phrase. 使用
words.ex: He makes use of old books to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他利用旧书来省钱。
words.en: To use something or someone in order to achieve a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 兴风作浪；制造纠纷
words.ex: He made waves by speaking truth to power.
words.ex_cn: 他敢于对权势说真话，引起了轰动。
words.en: To cause trouble or controversy, or to attract attention by doing something unusual or unexpected.

words.tr: phrase. 让路给；为…腾出空间；给…让位
words.ex: The old building was torn down to make way for a new park.
words.ex_cn: 旧建筑被拆除了，为新公园让路。
words.en: If you make way for someone or something, you move aside so that they can pass or so that there is space for them.

words.tr: phrase. 让路；让开；让位
words.ex: The crowd made way for the ambulance.
words.ex_cn: 人群为救护车让路。
words.en: To move aside or to allow someone or something to pass by.

chapters.name: 第一部分 基本动词MAKE补充词组

words.w: make a check out to sb.
words.tr: phrase. 开一张抬头为某人的支票；把支票开给某人
words.uk: meɪk ə tʃek aʊt tuː ˈsʌmbɒdi
words.us: meɪk ə tʃek aʊt tuː ˈsʌmbɑːdi
words.ex: He made a check out to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他开了一张支票给他的朋友。
words.en: To write a check payable to someone.

words.w: make out a check to sb.
words.tr: phrase. 开支票给某人；给某人开一张支票
words.uk: meɪk aʊt ə tʃɛk tuː ɛsb.
words.us: meɪk aʊt ə tʃɛk tu ɛsb.
words.ex: He made out a check to his landlord.
words.ex_cn: 他开了一张支票给他的房东。
words.en: To write a check payable to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 付账后离开；核实
words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
